Hi Samantha — thanks for the details and welcome.

Short answers:
- If Brightline is a US entity (EIN provided above looks like one), please send a completed, signed W-9 (pdf preferred) with the legal name exactly matching the EIN.
- We also require either a bank letter on letterhead showing the account ownership or a voided company check for ACH enrollment.
- Invoices should be emailed to ap-invoices@redwood.ai unless you need a supplier-specific mailbox — let us know.

Notes / things that'll speed setup:
- Legal entity name on the W-9 must match articles of incorporation if we have to validate. If there are DBA variants please include documentation.
- If your tax residency is outside the US, we'll need a W-8BEN-E instead — let me know right away.

I'll loop in Kimberly (procurement) and Ben (payments) to get a PO started once we have the W-9 and bank letter. If you prefer DocuSign for the W-9, I can send a link.

Cheers,
Diego Fernandez
